messages:
maria (SEC): heads-up, premerge SAST flagged a HIGH in repo `inference-runtime` on branch `canary/optimizations`. file: auth/checker.go :thinking_face:
scans-bot: [automated] SAST scan completed for inference-runtime @canary/optimizations — 1 HIGH (CWE-287/authorization bypass), 2 MEDIUM. details: https://scans.internal/reports/6112233445
dev-raj: link to the finding? I can't open corporate link from my laptop rn
maria (SEC): pasted snippet: `auth/checker.go:45 if user.Role == "service" || user.ID == resource.OwnerID { return allow }` — scanner says short-circuit allows service accounts to bypass an extra owner check.
leo-eng: hmm that code pattern is common. might be false positive if `service` roles are scoped. can you paste stack context?
maria (SEC): run context shows this path is used by the file upload endpoint which calls KMS decrypt for envelope keys just before authorization. interestingly, we don't have a KMS decrypt audit entry for the failing CI run (request id missing).
sam-oncall: did we recently change the service-account bindings for `scanner-runner@infra`? I pushed a RBAC tweak last week to allow read-only keystore listing.
dev-raj: @sam-oncall i made a change to project-level rolebindings two days ago to tighten svcacct perms (replaced broad role with narrow one). could that have removed decrypt permission?
sam-oncall: possible. i can check the IAM change log and the keystore audit. give me 5. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
scans-bot: [update] DAST nightly also flagged an open-redirect pattern on `/oauth/redirect` (LOW) in the same deploy preview. not sure related, posting for visibility.
maria (SEC): priority now: 1) confirm whether this is a real auth bypass or a scanner FP, 2) confirm KMS audit gap for CI run, 3) if real, block merge via premerge gate and issue rollback.
dev-raj: reproducing locally: i need ephemeral decrypt perms on dev-keystore to run the exact path. @maria (SEC) can you open ephemeral grant?
maria (SEC): opened request: https://idm/requests/GR-6112 — reviewers: leo-eng, sam-oncall. add notes: reproduce SAST path + attach stacktrace.
leo-eng: quick note on repro: run `make local-scan && ./bin/runtime --auth-mode dev` then hit `POST /upload` with test envelope. i attached the curl in the ticket.
maria (SEC): sam, any sign of missing audit entries in Cloud KMS? i searched for `requestId:6112233445-ci` and turned up nothing for decrypt operations between 03:10-03:20 UTC.
sam-oncall: confirmed: there was a short window where the keystore proxy returned 503 to CI pods; logs show `keystore-proxy: temporary backend error` at 03:12:11. that would explain no decrypt audit. i've raised infra incident INC-6112.
dev-raj: that makes it messy — the code path may have skipped owner fetch due to a timed flow; if KMS decrypt failed, we might have default fallback that grants `service` role earlier. checking.
maria (SEC): if fallback logic grants overly-broad allow on decrypt failure that's a bug. can someone grep for `||` fallback paths in auth module?
leo-eng: quick grep result: `auth/checker.go` has `if err != nil { log.Warn("keystore decrypt failed, allowing service account for backward compat") }` — oh. that's the problem. i'll open a PR to change to deny-by-default and add a feature-flag for emergency legacy mode.
maria (SEC): yes please. PR should: 1) change fallback to deny, 2) add unit + integration test, 3) add premerge policy to block if SAST HIGH exists.
sam-oncall: for the RBAC/IAM side, i'll roll back my recent binding change until we ensure decrypt perms consistently present for CI runner. also will check keystore-proxy retry config.
dev-raj: i'll take the code PR and test with ephemeral decrypt grant. timeline: aiming for patch in next 2 hours.
maria (SEC): created triage ticket SEC-6112 with actions + evidence (stacktrace + keystore logs + scan report). assigning to dev-raj and leo-eng. https://jira.local/browse/SEC-6112
scans-bot: [note] premerge policy change suggested: block merges when SAST > MEDIUM for auth packages (`/auth/*`). policy PR: https://infra.local/policies/431/update
maria (SEC): after patch we should run a canary rollout and watch `keystore.decrypt` audit logs for the next 30m. sam, open an alert if we see any further 503 spikes.
sam-oncall: set alert `keystore-proxy.error_rate > 5%` and `cloudkms.decrypt.missing_requests > 0` for 30m window. alert created: A-KE-6112.
leo-eng: PR opened: https://git.local/inference-runtime/pulls/987 — title: "auth: deny-on-keystore-failure + tests"
dev-raj: testing now with ephemeral. if green, i'll merge and trigger canary rollback/patch.
maria (SEC): cool. afterwards we should add a checklist to security review workflow: "verify fallback paths do not grant access when external subsystem fails" — I'll add to the security playbook.
leo-eng: noted. small follow-up: add a unit that simulates keystore 503 and asserts deny.
maria (SEC): exact plan captured in SEC-6112. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
scans-bot: [closed] temporary shield: premerge gate updated to run SAST twice for auth packages until policy rollouts are live.
